en: • Appeared in the completely new movie “Space Battleship Yamato 2199 Star-Coursing Ark”
• Total length approximately 350mm. Precise reproduction of every detail.
• The pattern on the top runway is reproduced with water transfer decals.
• Four carrier-based shell attack aircraft (Desbatator) of the same scale are included.
• Mechacolle style carapace attack aircraft <Desbatator> is also included.
Molded product x 8, water transfer seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
